subject: Manager Bridge Program: difficult conversations + performance calibration (pilot)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Manager Bridge Program: difficult conversations + performance calibration (pilot)

Team,

Following our last People sync, I pulled together a short proposal for a 6-week "Manager Bridge" pilot focused on two things we keep hearing: running better performance calibration and coaching managers through difficult conversations (early coaching, difficult feedback, and PIP conversations). Attachments: syllabus and a draft ROP (run of program).

High-level ask: can HR sponsor a June pilot cohort (6 managers) so we can iterate before rolling to all new managers in Q3? Specific asks below:

- HR to confirm budget and whether we can treat this under L&D (approx $12k vendor + 8 hrs internal time).
- People Ops to provide a list of manager candidates (individual contributors promoted in last 12 months or new managers < 6 months tenure).
- Legal/People to sign off on sensitive case handling and escalation path for PIPs.

Why this now: recent calibration exercises surfaced inconsistent expectations about coaching and escalation. Rather than only add another doc, this is a short blended program (1 workshop, 3 practice labs, 1 cohort coaching session) and a playbook managers can use immediately.

Links: drive folder with templates and the draft syllabus (see attachments).

Thoughts? happy to discuss over quick sync.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: DifficultConvos_Syllabus_v1.pdf; ManagerMentorship_ROP.docx

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager Bridge Program: difficult conversations + performance calibration (pilot)

Marcus — thanks for putting this together. This aligns with HR priorities for Q2 and we can sponsor the pilot. A few quick items: 

1) Budget: please confirm if the $12k is external vendor only and whether there are travel/room costs. We can likely cover vendor fees from L&D budget but need an approved PO.
2) Candidates: Priya, can you pull a list of 8 managers that fit the criteria (promoted in last 12 months OR hired as manager within last 6 months). We will pick 6.
3) Confidential cases: as you note, any live PIP cases must not be discussed in cohort exercises. We'll create sanitized role-play scenarios and HR will review participant lists ahead of time.

Laura — can People Ops add the program to the new manager checklist if pilot looks good?

If helpful I can draft a short approval memo for Finance. Also attaching the standard PIP and coaching templates we use.

Monica Patel
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: PIP_Template_v2.docx

From: Sarah Cole <sarah@catalystlead.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager Bridge Program: difficult conversations + performance calibration (pilot)

Thanks Marcus & team — great to meet you all. Catalyst Leadership Solutions is available to run the proposed pilot. I've attached a short SOW and a sample agenda: 3.5hr kickoff workshop + weekly 90-min practice labs + one live coaching session. We include pre-work (manager self-assessment) and a 30-day checklist for escalation.

Key items we need from you:
- Confirm proposed pilot dates (we've tentatively held June 9 kickoff).
- Confirm number of participants and any special accommodations (timezone/recording restrictions).
- Contract/SOW sign-off and PO.

We're happy to sign an NDA; we also propose a confidentiality addendum for any role-play that references real cases.

Best,
Sarah Cole
Principal Facilitator, Catalyst Leadership Solutions

Thanks everyone — I support running the pilot. A few leadership notes: 

- Approve the dates as proposed (June 9 kickoff). Please ensure the pilot cohort is diverse across function and tenure.
- For any PIP/escalation examples we use in role-play, HR must sanitize facts before sharing with Catalyst. No live employee names or case details.
- If a manager in the cohort is involved in an ongoing sensitive HR matter, route that case to Monica and me; we will handle escalations privately and remove that person from any public exercises.
- Metrics: please include a short pre/post self-efficacy survey and a 90-day manager check-in to evaluate behavior change.

Marcus — proceed to confirm with Catalyst and raise the PO. Monica — please draft the memo for Finance and copy me.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
VP, People & Talent
Redwood Inference
